summary: BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Alesta Therapeutics B.V., a Dutch biotech, via a share purchase agreement first disclosed on August 18, 2026. The transaction closed on August 31, 2026, making Alesta a wholly owned subsidiary. No financial terms—price per share, premium, or deal value—were disclosed in this filing. The purchase agreement was filed as Exhibit 2.1 to the prior 8-K. The structure is a straightforward share purchase of a private company. Watch for integration details or any contingent milestone payments in subsequent filings.
